1	import React from 'react';
2	import { chakra, useMultiStyleConfig } from '@chakra-ui/react';
3	import { Link as RouteLink } from 'react-router-dom';
4	import { defineMessages, useIntl } from 'react-intl';
5	import { ZimmProductName } from '../../atoms/zimmProductName';
6	import { ZimmProductPrice } from '../../atoms/zimmProductPrice';
7	import { ZimmIcon } from '../../atoms/zimmIcon';
8	import { ZimmSizeChipGroup } from '../zimmSizeChipGroup';
9	import type { ZimmSizeChipValue } from '../zimmSizeChipGroup';
10	import { CARD_SLOT } from '../../zimmProductCardShared';
11	
12	/**
13	 * Selector contract for a later step (the ZimmProductCard organism, SFCC-236 Step 6): stable
14	 * `data-card-slot` values on this component's own DOM so that organism's own recipe can target
15	 * these descendants for hover-reveal styling without reaching into implementation details.
16	 * Do not rename these values without updating that recipe too — mirrors the same contract
17	 * `zimmProductCardMedia/index.tsx` documents for its own slots:
18	 *   - "content"   — the outermost element (this component's root).
19	 *   - "price"     — the price wrapper. Always rendered regardless of variation; the organism's
20	 *                   own CSS is what shows/hides it on hover per variation (see the `showBag`/
21	 *                   `showSizeChips` props below), not this component.
22	 *   - "sizeChips" — the size-chip-group wrapper (present only when `showSizeChips` is true).
23	 *                   Always rendered in the DOM per Figma's `hidden=true` default on the "Size
24	 *                   Selector instance" node — the organism's hover-reveal CSS is what handles
25	 *                   visibility, not this component's own recipe (see zimmProductCardContent.css.ts).
26	 *   - "bag"       — the bag-button wrapper (present only when `showBag` is true). Added later
27	 *                   than the three above, for the organism's own mobile-breakpoint hide rule
28	 *                   (Figma: PLP/PDP's Mobile Card-content instances have the bag icon's `Icons`
29	 *                   frame `hidden="true"`; Desktop and Wishlist's own Mobile instance do not) — a
30	 *                   viewport-width concern, not a hover one, but the same
31	 *                   "this component always renders it, the organism's CSS decides visibility"
32	 *                   division of responsibility as the other slots.
33	 */
34	
35	// Same import base SFCC's own swatch-group/swatch.jsx uses for its `RouteLink`, and the same
36	// reasoning zimmColourSwatch/index.tsx already documents: a router `Link` delivers "URL updates
37	// without a full page reload" for real. Confirmed directly (no overrides/app/components/link/
38	// directory exists on disk) — there is no overrides/.../link equivalent to reuse instead.
39	const ProductNameLink = chakra(RouteLink);
40	
41	const messages = defineMessages({
42	  // Deliberately generic, not name-interpolated ("Add {name} to bag") — no such requirement was
43	  // given, and the visible product name already sits immediately to this button's left in the
44	  // same row, so the accessible name does not need to repeat it.
45	  addToBag: { id: 'product_card_content.bag.add_to_bag', defaultMessage: 'Add to bag' },
46	  // Figma node 40002163:41468 (Desktop, Hover, PLP/PDP, Unavailable=True) — an instance of the
47	  // shared CTA/Link atom (40001908:28374/40001908:28368) with its text swapped to "NOTIFY ME" in
48	  // this state. Authored here in sentence case, not literal caps, matching this codebase's
49	  // pattern of keeping translatable copy normal-case and letting the textStyle's CSS apply the
50	  // visual transform (see ZimmProductName's own normal-cased stories against `productNames`'
51	  // textTransform: 'uppercase') — `linkSm` was corrected to `textTransform: 'uppercase'` to
52	  // match (2026-09-03, theme/foundation/typography.ts), so this renders "NOTIFY ME" correctly.
53	  notifyMe: {
54	    id: 'product_card_content.notify_me.label',
55	    defaultMessage: 'Notify me',
56	  },
57	});
58	
59	const ZIMM_PRODUCT_CARD_CONTENT_RECIPE = 'ZimmProductCardContent';
60	
61	/**
62	 * `ZimmProductName`'s own heading-level prop, read off the atom's real signature via a utility
63	 * type rather than a hand-typed duplicate union (typescript.md: "prefer utility types over
64	 * hand-rolled duplicate shapes... a hand-copied type silently drifts from its source when the
65	 * original changes"). Its type param is `'h1' | 'h2' | 'h3'` — note this is NOT `'h2' | 'h3' |
66	 * 'h4'` as an earlier sketch of this component's contract assumed; see `headingLevel` below.
67	 */
68	type ZimmProductNameHeadingLevel = React.ComponentProps<typeof ZimmProductName>['as'];
69	
70	export type ZimmProductCardContentProps = {
71	  /** The product's display name, rendered as the card's heading and link text. */
72	  name: string;
73	  /**
74	   * Heading level for the composed `ZimmProductName`, forwarded to it as `as`. Named
75	   * `headingLevel` here (rather than `as`) because this component is not itself polymorphic —
76	   * it always renders the same fixed element tree, it just hands the one real heading a level.
77	   * Typed as `ZimmProductNameHeadingLevel` (`'h1' | 'h2' | 'h3'`) to exactly match what that atom
78	   * actually accepts — a prior sketch of this contract assumed `'h2' | 'h3' | 'h4'`, which is
79	   * wrong on both ends: the atom has no `'h4'` at all, and it does accept `'h1'` (unlikely in
80	   * practice for a grid card, but not this component's place to forbid what the atom allows).
81	   */
82	  headingLevel: ZimmProductNameHeadingLevel;
83	  /**
84	   * PDP destination for the product name link. Not passed through `isSafeHref` — unlike
85	   * `ZimmNavItem`/`ZimmContactIconRow`'s CMS-sourced hrefs, this is an SFCC-generated product URL,
86	   * the same trust level `ZimmColourSwatch`'s own `href` prop already assumes.
87	   */
88	  href: string;
89	  /** Passed straight through to the composed `ZimmProductPrice`. */
90	  currentPrice?: string;
91	  /** Passed straight through to the composed `ZimmProductPrice`. */
92	  originalPrice?: string;
93	  /** Passed straight through to `ZimmProductPrice`'s own `isLoading`. */
94	  isPriceLoading?: boolean;
95	
96	  /**
97	   * Wishlist-only attributes line (colour + size as plain text), per the organism's
98	   * VARIATION_CONFIG (Step 6, not built yet) — this component only ever sees the resolved
99	   * boolean, never a variation name. When false the row is absent from the DOM entirely, not
100	   * merely visually hidden.
101	   */
102	  showAttributes: boolean;
103	  /**
104	   * Rendered only when `showAttributes` is true. Pass the plain colour value ("Ivory", not
105	   * "Ivory,") — the component itself appends the trailing comma when rendering, matching
106	   * Figma's own text-node structure (confirmed via get_design_context on node 40002187:58446:
107	   * the colour text node's own content literally includes the trailing comma, e.g. "Lilac
108	   * Sand,", not a separate punctuation node). See the `colourWithComma` derivation below.
109	   */
110	  colour?: string;
111	  /** Rendered only when `showAttributes` is true. */
112	  size?: string;
113	
114	  /** Renders the bag button (Figma "Icon_bag" — confirmed a bag action, not a wishlist star). */
115	  showBag: boolean;
116	  /** Disables the bag button (native `disabled`) when true. `onAddToBag` never fires in that state. */
117	  isUnavailable?: boolean;
118	  onAddToBag?: () => void;
119	
120	  /**
121	   * PLP-only size-chip picker, per the organism's config. Always rendered in the DOM whenever
122	   * true — Figma's `hidden=true` default on this slot is a hover-reveal CSS concern for the
123	   * Step 6 organism, not something this component enforces on itself. See the module docblock's
124	   * `data-card-slot="sizeChips"` note.
125	   */
126	  showSizeChips: boolean;
127	  sizeChipValues?: ZimmSizeChipValue[];
128	  selectedSizeChipValue?: string;
129	  onSizeChipSelect?: (value: string) => void;
130	
131	  /**
132	   * True whenever the caller has resolved "this is unavailable" (the organism's job) — no longer
133	   * additionally gated on a real `onNotifyMe` handler existing. Changed 2026-09-08, Marcel's
134	   * explicit decision: see this file's own `showNotifyMeButton` comment below for why.
135	   */
136	  showNotifyMe: boolean;
137	  onNotifyMe?: () => void;
138	};
139	
140	/**
141	 * Molecule — the product-card text-content block: heading/link, bag action, wishlist-only
142	 * colour/size attributes, price, PLP-only size-chip picker, and an out-of-stock notify-me CTA.
143	 * Figma "Card-content" component set, node 40002109:26908 (Desktop 40002109:26906 / Mobile
144	 * 40002163:37103).
145	 *
146	 * Deliberately has NO remove/close button — that action lives entirely in
147	 * `ZimmProductCardMedia`'s own `close` overlay (Step 4), positioned on the image, not here.
148	 *
149	 * Also deliberately has no badge slot, despite the SFCC-236 AC mentioning one for PLP/Wishlist.
150	 * An earlier revision of this paragraph claimed no Figma design existed for it at all — that
151	 * was wrong: the badge (Figma "Tag") does exist, confirmed present and identical across every
152	 * Size/Type variant checked. It just lives inside "Image Group", which is
153	 * `ZimmProductCardMedia`'s domain, not this component's — so it was built there instead. See
154	 * that component's own docblock for the confirmed spec, and the organism's own docblock
155	 * ("Badge" note) for which variations actually show it.
156	 *
157	 * Composes `ZimmProductPrice` with `isLive={false}` unconditionally — this is the entire reason
158	 * that prop exists (SFCC-236 Step 3): a grid of these on a PLP must not mount dozens of
159	 * `aria-live` regions whose price never changes post-mount.
160	 */
161	export const ZimmProductCardContent = ({
162	  name,
163	  headingLevel,
164	  href,
165	  currentPrice,
166	  originalPrice,
167	  isPriceLoading,
168	  showAttributes,
169	  colour,
170	  size,
171	  showBag,
172	  isUnavailable,
173	  onAddToBag,
174	  showSizeChips,
175	  sizeChipValues,
176	  selectedSizeChipValue,
177	  onSizeChipSelect,
178	  showNotifyMe,
179	  onNotifyMe,
180	}: ZimmProductCardContentProps) => {
181	  const intl = useIntl();
182	  // `disabled`, not `isUnavailable` — matches `recipeGuards.test.ts`'s own `DEFAULT_STYLE_PROPS`
183	  // key so that guard's exhaustive prop-combination walk actually exercises both the true and
184	  // false branch of `bagButton`'s disabled styling (see zimmProductCardContent.css.ts's own
185	  // comment, and `zimmSizeChip.css.ts`'s identical `disabled` naming for the same reason).
186	  const styles = useMultiStyleConfig(ZIMM_PRODUCT_CARD_CONTENT_RECIPE, { disabled: isUnavailable });
187	
188	  // Was `showNotifyMe && Boolean(onNotifyMe)` — changed 2026-09-08, Marcel's explicit decision.
189	  // The real Notify Me feature (PRD-018–021: a slide-out form submitting to a back-in-stock
190	  // capture target) doesn't exist anywhere in this codebase yet, including on PDP where this
191	  // same prop concept already exists unused — building it is its own future story, not this
192	  // change. Until then, the button ships visible and genuinely inert: `onClick={onNotifyMe}`
193	  // below is a plain prop reference, and `onNotifyMe` stays optional on this component's own
194	  // props — React treats an `undefined` event handler as "no handler attached" (not an error),
195	  // so a click with none supplied safely does nothing.
196	  const showNotifyMeButton = showNotifyMe;
197	
198	  // Figma renders the colour/size attributes line as ONE continuous phrase, not two independent
199	  // labels: the comma is baked into the colour text node's own content ("Lilac Sand,"), not a
200	  // separate punctuation element — confirmed via get_design_context on node 40002187:58446 (the
201	  // real Wishlist Card-content instance). Reproduced the same way here, on the colour value's own
202	  // rendered string (never as a static comma JSX node between the two spans), paired with
203	  // attributesRow's 2px gap (zimmProductCardContent.css.ts) for the "Ivory, M" breathing room —
204	  // verified by rendering the real Futura Round Medium caption style at actual size: the glyph
205	  // ink-to-ink gap the 2px flex gap produces here reads as a genuine (if slightly tighter than
206	  // full-prose) space, not as "Ivory,M" touching. Guarded against `colour` being falsy so a
207	  // caller omitting it (a contract violation, but not this component's job to enforce) still
208	  // renders nothing, rather than the literal string "undefined,".
209	  const colourWithComma = colour ? `${colour},` : colour;
210	
211	  return (
212	    <chakra.div __css={styles.root} data-card-slot={CARD_SLOT.content}>
213	      <chakra.div __css={styles.nameRow}>
214	        <ProductNameLink to={href} __css={styles.nameLink}>
215	          <ZimmProductName name={name} as={headingLevel} />
216	        </ProductNameLink>
217	
218	        {showBag && (
219	          <chakra.div __css={styles.bagWrapper} data-card-slot={CARD_SLOT.bag}>
220	            <chakra.button
221	              type="button"
222	              __css={styles.bagButton}
223	              aria-label={intl.formatMessage(messages.addToBag)}
224	              disabled={isUnavailable}
225	              onClick={() => {
226	                // Belt-and-braces: the native `disabled` attribute already prevents the browser
227	                // from ever dispatching this click, but stating the invariant explicitly means a
228	                // reader doesn't have to recall that fact to trust onAddToBag can't fire while
229	                // unavailable. Same idiom as ZimmSizeChip's own onClick guard.
230	                if (isUnavailable) return;
231	                onAddToBag?.();
232	              }}
233	            >
234	              <ZimmIcon type="bag" aria-hidden />
235	            </chakra.button>
236	          </chakra.div>
237	        )}
238	      </chakra.div>
239	
240	      {showAttributes && (
241	        <chakra.div __css={styles.attributesRow} data-testid="card-content-attributes">
242	          <chakra.span __css={styles.colourText}>{colourWithComma}</chakra.span>
243	          <chakra.span __css={styles.sizeText}>{size}</chakra.span>
244	        </chakra.div>
245	      )}
246	
247	      <chakra.div __css={styles.priceWrapper} data-card-slot={CARD_SLOT.price}>
248	        <ZimmProductPrice
249	          currentPrice={currentPrice}
250	          originalPrice={originalPrice}
251	          isLoading={isPriceLoading}
252	          isLive={false}
253	        />
254	      </chakra.div>
255	
256	      {showSizeChips && (
257	        <chakra.div __css={styles.sizeChipWrapper} data-card-slot={CARD_SLOT.sizeChips}>
258	          <ZimmSizeChipGroup
259	            values={sizeChipValues ?? []}
260	            selectedValue={selectedSizeChipValue}
261	            onSelect={onSizeChipSelect}
262	          />
263	        </chakra.div>
264	      )}
265	
266	      {showNotifyMeButton && (
267	        <chakra.button
268	          type="button"
269	          __css={styles.notifyMeButton}
270	          onClick={onNotifyMe}
271	          data-card-slot={CARD_SLOT.notifyMe}
272	        >
273	          {intl.formatMessage(messages.notifyMe)}
274	        </chakra.button>
275	      )}
276	    </chakra.div>
277	  );
278	};
279	
280	export default ZimmProductCardContent;

## Accessibility audit — SFCC-83/84 diff (merge-base `3cec638`..`HEAD`, 39 commits, 22 non-test files) ### CONFIRMED findings **1. Hover-swap image pair double-announces to screen readers.** `zimmProductCardMedia/index.tsx:339-358` renders both `data-role="hover-base"` and `data-role="hover-overlay"` as real, simultaneously-mounted `` elements, each with its own real, distinct `alt` text — only `opacity` (`zimmProductCardMedia.css.ts` base styles + the card-level `:has(:focus-visible)`/`:hover` toggle) distinguishes which is visually shown. `opacity` does not remove an element from the accessibility tree (only `display:none`/`visibility:hidden`/`aria-hidden` do) — so a screen reader reading this card announces **both** alt texts back-to-back regardless of hover/focus state. This is reachable on the Full History page today: `recentlyViewedFullHistoryCard.ts:398` sets `hoverImage: scopedImages[1]` (a real second image) and `VARIATION_CONFIG.plp.showHoverImageSwap: true` (`zimmProductCard/index.tsx:417`). Contrast: the Rail's own `recentlyViewed` variation solved the analogous "image needs one clean accessible name" problem correctly (`alt=''` override + `VisuallyHidden` link name, `zimmProductCard/index.tsx:655-660`) — this is the same class of problem, unaddressed for the hover-swap pair specifically. Screen-reader-only. Owner: whoever owns `zimmProductCardMedia` (fix is CSS-adjacent: mark the currently-hidden image `aria-hidden` dynamically, or `alt=""` on the overlay). **2. `notifyMeButton` fails WCAG 2.2 AA SC 2.5.8 (24px touch target).** `zimmProductCardContent.css.ts:211-230` — no `width`/`height`/`minHeight`, `padding: 0`, relying solely on `textStyle: 'linkSm'`'s `lineHeight: lineHeights['4xs']` = **14px** (`typography.ts:19,168`). Its three siblings in the same card (`bagButton`, `close`, `arrowButton`) all explicitly set `24px`/`48px` with an inline "meets WCAG 2.5.8" comment, and the Rail's own `seeAllLink` handles the identical "standalone, not-inline-in-a-sentence" case via `paddingBlock` specifically citing 2.5.8 (`zimmRecentlyViewedRail.css.ts:271-280`). This button renders as a standalone block CTA (`display:'block'`), so the inline-text exemption doesn't apply. Motor/pointer-precision issue, not keyboard/screen-reader-blocking. Owner: whoever owns `zimmProductCardContent`. **3. Badge label has no background scrim against the product photo.** `zimmProductCardMedia.css.ts:128-148` — `badge` sets no `background`; `badgeLabel` renders `color: var(--zimm-color-text-default)` directly over the photographic image. Contrast is uncontrolled — depends entirely on whatever the product photo's own colours are in that corner.
